# Flutter / Dart

- Backend calls, PKCE pairs and nonces are implemented only in `lib/src/flow/` (`SocialFlow`, `Pkce`, `Nonce`). A driver calls them (`Pkce.generate()`, `Nonce.generate()`, `SocialFlow.token`) and never builds its own request, verifier or nonce: one implementation keeps every flow single-use and the wire format identical across drivers.
